attributes.board_name: Georgia State Board of Examiners of Psychologists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Area I academic/instruction/publications (max 20); Area II ongoing group consultation (10-20 if used, in person or synchronous); Area III approved sponsored CE (max 40) - APA- or CPA-approved sponsors, state psychological associations, specialty academies, accredited institutions, qualifying government entities, certain AMA/CMA and bar CE
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed in the first (odd) year of the biennium: 20 credits incl. 3 ethics; licensed in the second (even) year: no CE for the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: The Board audits a fixed percentage of renewal applications; certificates required for Area III activities.
rules.notes: Biennium Jan 1 of an odd year to Dec 31 of the following even year. 6 ethics credits must be earned at a workshop attended in person or by synchronous webinar. Area III may be in person, synchronous or asynchronous.
